# The Star

> Kenya's leading news source delivering breaking news, politics, sports, entertainment, and international coverage with focus on education reform and domestic policy.

The Star is Kenya's premier news organization covering national and international events. The site emphasizes breaking news, political developments, and significant policy initiatives including Kenya's transition to competency-based education (CBC) in universities.
